question.text: A portfolio has gross return 22%, other expenses 0.5%, fixed management fee 2%, and performance fee 3% over the year. What is the NET return?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Net return = Gross - all fees = 22% - 0.5% - 2% - 3% = 16.5%. **The Trap:** 19.5% forgets performance fee; 22% is gross; 12% over-subtracts. **Cross-Exam Context:** XXI-A covers fees from Distributor side; XXI-B from PM side. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Always distinguish gross vs net return in investor communications — SEBI explicitly requires net-of-fees reporting.
